```{r Spatial Multi-Omics Data Import, Preprocessing and Imputation Functions}
#' Generate Separate RNA and ATAC Cell-to-Cell Similarity Graphs
#'
#' \code{generateSeparateModalGraphs()} creates independent cell-to-cell similarity graphs
#' for spatial RNA-seq and spatial ATAC-seq data. The RNA graph is based on PCA embeddings,
#' and the ATAC graph is based on gene activity scores derived from peak aggregation,
#' followed by sparse PCA and KNN graph construction.
#'
#' @param seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed Preprocessed Seurat object for spatial RNA-seq.
#' @param atac_counts_matrix_filtered Sparse matrix of ATAC-seq peak counts (cells x peaks).
#' @param atac_peaks_gr_filtered `GRanges` object of ATAC-seq peaks.
#' @param genome Genome build (e.g., "hg38") for ATAC gene activity.
#' @param rna_feature_dims Integer vector of PCs for RNA feature graph (e.g., 1:30).
#' @param rna_feature_k_neighbors Integer, k for RNA feature KNN graph.
#' @param atac_pca_dims Integer, number of principal components to use for ATAC graph construction.
#' @param atac_k_neighbors Integer, the number of nearest neighbors to consider for each cell
#'                         in the ATAC KNN graph.
#' @return A list containing:
#'   \itemize{
#'     \item `rna_graph`: Sparse matrix of RNA-based cell-to-cell similarity.
#'     \item `atac_graph`: Sparse matrix of ATAC-based cell-to-cell similarity.
#'     \item `atac_gene_activity_matrix`: The gene activity matrix derived from ATAC peaks (useful for ATAC-specific cell typing or visualization).
#'   }
#' @export
generateSeparateModalGraphs <- function(
    seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed,
    atac_counts_matrix_filtered,
    atac_peaks_gr_filtered,
    genome = "hg38",
    rna_feature_dims = 1:30,
    rna_feature_k_neighbors = 20,
    atac_pca_dims = 30,
    atac_k_neighbors = 20
) {
  message("Starting `generateSeparateModalGraphs` pipeline...")

  # 1. Create RNA Feature Graph
  rna_graph <- createRNACellGraph(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed, dims = rna_feature_dims, k_neighbors = rna_feature_k_neighbors)
  rna_cell_ids <- colnames(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed)
  if (is.null(rna_graph) || nrow(rna_graph) == 0) {
    warning("RNA Feature Graph could not be created meaningfully (empty or NULL). Returning a zero matrix for RNA graph.")
    rna_graph <- Matrix::Matrix(0, length(rna_cell_ids), length(rna_cell_ids), sparse = TRUE, dimnames = list(rna_cell_ids, rna_cell_ids))
  }

  # 2. Create ATAC Gene Activity Matrix
  atac_gene_activity_matrix <- createPeakBasedGeneActivityMatrix(
    atac_counts_matrix = atac_counts_matrix_filtered,
    atac_peaks_gr = atac_peaks_gr_filtered,
    genome = genome
  )

  # 3. Create ATAC Feature Graph (using new PCA+KNN approach)
  atac_graph <- createATACCellGraph(
    atac_gene_activity_matrix, 
    atac_pca_dims = atac_pca_dims,    
    atac_k_neighbors = atac_k_neighbors 
  )
  atac_cell_ids <- rownames(atac_gene_activity_matrix) # Use IDs from the gene activity matrix
  if (is.null(atac_graph) || nrow(atac_graph) == 0) {
      warning("ATAC Feature Graph could not be created meaningfully (empty or NULL). Returning a zero matrix for ATAC graph.")
      atac_graph <- Matrix::Matrix(0, length(atac_cell_ids), length(atac_cell_ids), sparse = TRUE, dimnames = list(atac_cell_ids, atac_cell_ids))
  }

  message("`generateSeparateModalGraphs` pipeline complete. Returning separate RNA and ATAC graphs.")
  return(list(
    rna_graph = rna_graph,
    atac_graph = atac_graph,
    atac_gene_activity_matrix = atac_gene_activity_matrix
  ))
}


#' Compute Label Edges
#'
#' \code{computeTypeEdges} generates a matrix of edges from each cell type label to each cell from gene expression.
#' The edge weight is normalized gene expression of markers weighted by the log2FC.
#'
#' @param exprMat_norm a gene by cell data.frame or matrix, rownames are genes, colnames are cell barcodes
#' @param markers marker genes for each cell type, columns are gene, cluster, p_val_adj (optional) and avg_log2FC (optional).
#' @param pval.cutoff select markers with adjust pvalue (\code{p_val_adj}) < pval.cutoff. Default: 0.05
#' @param log2FC.cutoff select markers with abs(log2FC.cutoff)> 0.5 if only.pos = F or log2FC.cutoff>0.5 if only.pos = T. Default: 0.5
#' @param only.pos only include positive markers
#' @param force if true (default), this function will use marker genes that matched the name in exprMat_norm to compute edge weight;
#'              if false, this function will raise an error if some marker genes are not in exprMat_norm.
#' @return a matrix of edges from each cell type label to each cell
#' @export
#' @import data.table
changedCellWalkercomputeTypeEdges <- function(exprMat_norm, markers, pval.cutoff = 0.05, log2FC.cutoff = 0.5, only.pos = FALSE, force = TRUE)
{
  if(!requireNamespace("data.table", quietly = TRUE)){
    stop("Must install data.table")
  }
  if(missing(exprMat_norm) || (!is(exprMat_norm, "data.frame") & !is(exprMat_norm, "matrix")  & !is(exprMat_norm, "Matrix"))){
    stop("Must provide a dataframe or matrix of RNA data")
  }
  if(is.null(colnames(exprMat_norm)) | is.null(rownames(exprMat_norm)))
  {
    stop('exprMat_norm must have column and row names')
  }
  if(missing(markers) || !is(markers, "data.frame")){
    stop("Must provide a dataframe of markers")
  }
  if(is.null(markers$gene) || is.null(markers$cluster)){
    stop("markers must have 'gene' and 'cluster' columns")
  }


  if(is.null(markers$avg_log2FC)) {
    warning('avg_log2FC is not present in the columns of markers, so markers will not be filtered by avg_log2FC')
    markers$avg_log2FC = log2FC.cutoff # Assign a default, but note it's not a true value
  }
  if(is.null(markers$p_val_adj)) {
    warning('p_val_adj is not present in the columns of markers, so markers will not be filtered by p_val_adj')
    markers$p_val_adj =  pval.cutoff # Assign a default, but note it's not a true value
  }

  markers = data.table(markers)
  if(only.pos)
  {
    markers = markers[avg_log2FC >= log2FC.cutoff & p_val_adj <= pval.cutoff]
  }else{
    markers = markers[abs(avg_log2FC) >= log2FC.cutoff & p_val_adj <= pval.cutoff]
  }

  if(force == FALSE)
  {
    stopifnot(all(markers$gene %in% rownames(exprMat_norm)))
  }
  
  # Filter markers to only include those present in the expression matrix
  markers_inter <- markers[markers$gene %in% rownames(exprMat_norm)]

  if(length(unique(markers_inter$cluster)) < length(unique(markers$cluster)))
  {
    # This check needs to be more careful if any cluster completely loses all its markers
    # It might be better to check each unique cluster from the original markers.
    original_clusters <- unique(markers$cluster)
    clusters_with_markers_after_filter <- unique(markers_inter$cluster)
    missing_clusters <- setdiff(original_clusters, clusters_with_markers_after_filter)
    if (length(missing_clusters) > 0) {
      stop(paste("The following clusters lost all their markers after filtering and intersection with expression matrix:",
                 paste(missing_clusters, collapse = ", "),
                 ". Need to lower the pval/logFC thresholds or check if expression matrix contains the markers."))
    }
  }
  
  # Ensure genes in exprMat_norm are ordered consistently with markers_inter for the calculation
  # This might not be strictly necessary if .SD[['gene']] is always correctly indexed,
  # but it's a good practice to be aware of potential indexing mismatches with sparse matrices.
  
  # --- CRITICAL FIX HERE: Use drop = FALSE to ensure subsetting always returns a matrix-like object ---
  labelEdges = markers_inter[, {
    # Extract genes for the current cluster
    current_genes <- .SD[['gene']]
    
    # Subset exprMat_norm, ensuring it remains a matrix even for single genes
    subset_expr_mat <- exprMat_norm[current_genes, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # Extract log2FC values, ensuring they align with the subset_expr_mat rows
    # This step is crucial if current_genes is not guaranteed to be in the same order as rownames(subset_expr_mat)
    # However, since we filter markers_inter by exprMat_norm rownames, and .SD[['gene']] comes from markers_inter,
    # the order should be preserved for the multiplication.
    # We explicitly match just to be extra safe, though for direct multiplication,
    # the vector is recycled against the rows of the matrix, which usually works if lengths match.
    # To be absolutely sure, it might be safer to ensure avg_log2FC is aligned.
    
    # A simpler approach, relying on vector recycling, is usually sufficient and less code:
    gene_log2FC <- .SD[['avg_log2FC']]
    
    # Perform element-wise multiplication and then colSums
    # The matrix subset_expr_mat will have genes as rows, cells as columns
    # gene_log2FC will be a vector of length = number of genes in current_genes
    # R will recycle gene_log2FC down the columns of subset_expr_mat for multiplication
    weighted_expr <- subset_expr_mat * gene_log2FC
    
    # Check for zero sum of absolute log2FC to avoid division by zero
    sum_abs_log2FC <- sum(abs(gene_log2FC))
    score_val <- if (sum_abs_log2FC > 0) {
                   colSums(weighted_expr) / sum_abs_log2FC
                 } else {
                   rep(0, ncol(exprMat_norm)) # If no valid log2FC, score is 0
                 }
                 
    list("score" = score_val, "cell" = colnames(exprMat_norm))
  }, by = cluster]
  # --- END CRITICAL FIX ---
  
  labelEdges = reshape2::acast(labelEdges, cell~cluster, value.var = 'score')
  labelEdges[labelEdges <0] = 0

  labelEdges
}


# --- Plotting functions for quick visualization and validation ---

# (User provided this, including here for completeness of testing)
plot_spatial_rna_atac <- function(rna_spatial_coords_df, atac_spatial_coords_df,
                                  color_by_rna = NULL, color_by_atac = NULL,
                                  pt_size = 0.6, pt_alpha = 0.8,
                                  same_limits = FALSE,
                                  rna_title = "RNA (spatial)",
                                  atac_title = "ATAC (spatial)") {

  if (nrow(rna_spatial_coords_df) == 0 && nrow(atac_spatial_coords_df) == 0) {
    message("No spatial coordinates to plot.")
    return(ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No data to plot") + theme_void())
  }

  # Common limits
  if (same_limits) {
    xlim <- range(c(rna_spatial_coords_df$x, atac_spatial_coords_df$x), na.rm = TRUE)
    ylim <- range(c(rna_spatial_coords_df$y, atac_spatial_coords_df$y), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else { xlim <- ylim <- NULL }

  make_plot <- function(df, title, color_col) {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) + 
      coord_fixed() + ggtitle(title) + theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
    if (!is.null(xlim)) p <- p + xlim(xlim) + ylim(ylim)
    if (!is.null(color_col)) {
      if (is.numeric(df[[color_col]])) {
        p <- p + geom_point(aes_string(color = color_col), size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha) +
          scale_color_viridis_c()
      } else {
        p <- p + geom_point(aes_string(color = color_col), size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha) +
          scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", na.value = "grey70")
      }
    } else {
      p <- p + geom_point(color = "#2c3e50", size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha)
    }
    p + xlab("x") + ylab("y")
  }
  
  # Only create plots if data exists
  p_rna <- if (nrow(rna_spatial_coords_df) > 0) make_plot(rna_spatial_coords_df, rna_title, color_by_rna) else NULL
  p_atac <- if (nrow(atac_spatial_coords_df) > 0) make_plot(atac_spatial_coords_df, atac_title, color_by_atac) else NULL

  if (is.null(p_rna) && is.null(p_atac)) {
      return(ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No data to plot") + theme_void())
  } else if (is.null(p_rna)) {
      return(p_atac)
  } else if (is.null(p_atac)) {
      return(p_rna)
  } else {
      plot_grid(p_rna, p_atac, ncol = 1, align = "v", rel_heights = c(1, 1))
  }
}


#' Plot Spatial and Graph Coherence for Validation
#'
#' \code{plotSpatialGraphCoherence()} visualizes the relationship between graph-based
#' neighbors and spatially proximate neighbors for a subset of cells.
#' This helps to validate if the non-spatial (RNA+ATAC) graph preserves spatial patterns.
#'
#' @param combined_rna_atac_graph The combined cell-to-cell graph (sparse matrix, RNA spots as nodes).
#' @param rna_spatial_coords_df Data.frame of RNA spatial coordinates (cell_id, x, y).
#' @param n_query_cells Integer, number of random query cells to pick for plotting.
#' @param k_neighbors_to_show Integer, number of graph/spatial neighbors to highlight for each query cell.
#' @param background_alpha Numeric, alpha value for 'Other' cells (0 to 1). Lower means more transparent.
#' @param neighbor_pt_size Numeric, point size for neighbor cells.
#' @param query_pt_size Numeric, point size for query cells.
#' @return A ggplot object visualizing query cells, their graph neighbors, and their spatial neighbors.
#' @export
plotSpatialGraphCoherence <- function(combined_rna_atac_graph, rna_spatial_coords_df, 
                                      n_query_cells = 5, k_neighbors_to_show = 10,
                                      background_alpha = 0.05, neighbor_pt_size = 1.8, query_pt_size = 3.5) {
  if (!requireNamespace("RANN", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'RANN' is required for spatial coherence plotting. Please install it with install.packages('RANN')")
  }
  if (nrow(rna_spatial_coords_df) == 0 || nrow(combined_rna_atac_graph) == 0) {
    message("No cells available for plotting spatial graph coherence.")
    return(ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No data to plot") + theme_void())
  }

  num_cells <- nrow(rna_spatial_coords_df)
  cell_ids <- rownames(rna_spatial_coords_df)

  if (k_neighbors_to_show >= num_cells) {
    warning("k_neighbors_to_show (", k_neighbors_to_show, ") is greater than or equal to the number of cells (", num_cells, "). Adjusting k_neighbors_to_show to num_cells - 1.")
    k_neighbors_to_show <- max(1, num_cells - 1)
  }
  if (k_neighbors_to_show == 0) {
    message("No neighbors can be shown (k_neighbors_to_show is 0). Only query cells will be plotted with 'Other' cells in background.")
  }

  query_cells <- sample(cell_ids, min(n_query_cells, num_cells))
  
  message("Analyzing graph and spatial coherence for ", length(query_cells), " query cells...")
  
  cells_to_plot_per_query <- list()

  for (q_id in query_cells) {
    # Get graph neighbors
    graph_sims <- combined_rna_atac_graph[q_id, ]
    
    graph_neighbors_indices_all <- order(graph_sims, decreasing = TRUE)
    q_id_idx_in_graph <- match(q_id, cell_ids)
    if (length(graph_neighbors_indices_all) > 0 && graph_neighbors_indices_all[1] == q_id_idx_in_graph) {
      graph_neighbors_indices_all <- graph_neighbors_indices_all[-1] # Remove self
    }
    graph_neighbors <- cell_ids[graph_neighbors_indices_all[1:min(k_neighbors_to_show, length(graph_neighbors_indices_all))]]
    
    spatial_coords_matrix <- as.matrix(rna_spatial_coords_df[, c("x", "y")])
    spatial_nn_result <- RANN::nn2(
      query = spatial_coords_matrix[q_id, , drop = FALSE],
      data = spatial_coords_matrix,
      k = k_neighbors_to_show + 1 
    )
    spatial_neighbors_indices <- spatial_nn_result$nn.idx[1, ]
    spatial_neighbors <- cell_ids[spatial_neighbors_indices[-1]] 
    spatial_neighbors <- spatial_neighbors[spatial_neighbors %in% cell_ids]
    spatial_neighbors <- spatial_neighbors[1:min(k_neighbors_to_show, length(spatial_neighbors))]

    current_query_cells <- data.frame(
      cell = c(q_id, graph_neighbors, spatial_neighbors),
      type = c("Query", rep("Graph Neighbor", length(graph_neighbors)), rep("Spatial Neighbor", length(spatial_neighbors))),
      query_id = q_id,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    overlap_neighbors <- intersect(graph_neighbors, spatial_neighbors)
    current_query_cells$type[match(overlap_neighbors, current_query_cells$cell)] <- "Both Graph & Spatial"
    
    cells_to_plot_per_query[[q_id]] <- current_query_cells
  }

  if (length(query_cells) == 0) {
      return(ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = paste("No query cells were selected for plotting")) + theme_void())
  }
  
  plot_data_list <- list()
  for (q_id_facet in query_cells) { 
    current_facet_data <- rna_spatial_coords_df
    current_facet_data$type <- "Other"
    current_facet_data$query_id <- q_id_facet 
    current_facet_data$cell <- rownames(current_facet_data)

    q_data_for_facet <- cells_to_plot_per_query[[q_id_facet]]
    
    if (nrow(q_data_for_facet) > 0) { 
        for (i in 1:nrow(q_data_for_facet)) {
            cell_id_to_update <- q_data_for_facet$cell[i]
            match_row_idx <- match(cell_id_to_update, rownames(current_facet_data))
            if (!is.na(match_row_idx)) {
                current_facet_data[match_row_idx, "type"] <- q_data_for_facet$type[i]
            }
        }
    }
    plot_data_list[[q_id_facet]] <- current_facet_data
  }
  
  final_plot_data <- do.call(rbind, plot_data_list)
  
  plot_type_levels <- c("Other", "Spatial Neighbor", "Graph Neighbor", "Both Graph & Spatial", "Query")
  final_plot_data$type <- factor(final_plot_data$type, levels = plot_type_levels)
  final_plot_data$query_id <- factor(final_plot_data$query_id, levels = unique(final_plot_data$query_id))

  p <- ggplot(final_plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_point(data = filter(final_plot_data, type == "Other"), aes(color = type), size = 0.5, alpha = background_alpha) +
    geom_point(data = filter(final_plot_data, type == "Spatial Neighbor"), aes(color = type), size = neighbor_pt_size, shape = 11, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = filter(final_plot_data, type == "Graph Neighbor"), aes(color = type), size = neighbor_pt_size, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = filter(final_plot_data, type == "Both Graph & Spatial"), aes(color = type), size = neighbor_pt_size + 0.5, alpha = 0.9, shape = 1) +
    geom_point(data = filter(final_plot_data, type == "Query"), aes(color = type), size = query_pt_size, shape = 8, stroke = 1.2) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Other" = "grey",
      "Spatial Neighbor" = "#8c510a", 
      "Graph Neighbor" = "#01665e",   
      "Both Graph & Spatial" = "#542788", 
      "Query" = "red"
    )) +
    facet_wrap(~query_id) +
    labs(title = "Graph and Spatial Neighborhood Coherence", color = "Cell Type") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "bottom",
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)) +
    coord_fixed() 

  message("Spatial graph coherence plot generated.")
  return(p)
}


#' Assess Overall Spatial-Graph Coherence
#'
#' \code{assessSpatialGraphCoherenceOverall()} quantifies and visualizes the global coherence
#' between feature-based cell similarity graphs and spatial proximity for a given modality.
#' For each cell, it calculates four key metrics:
#' \itemize{
#'   \item{\strong{Median Spatial Distance to Feature-Graph Neighbors (MSD-FGN):}} For each cell, this metric finds its `k` nearest neighbors based on feature similarity (from the `feature_graph`). It then calculates the median *Euclidean spatial distance* to these `k` feature-similar cells. A \strong{lower} median distance indicates that cells that are transcriptionally/epigenetically similar tend to be spatially close, suggesting good spatial preservation of feature similarity.
#'   \item{\strong{Median Feature-Graph Similarity to Spatial Neighbors (MFS-SN):}} For each cell, this metric finds its `k` nearest neighbors based on *spatial proximity*. It then calculates the median *cosine similarity* (using `feature_matrix_for_similarity`) between the query cell and these `k` spatially close neighbors. A \strong{higher} median similarity indicates that spatially adjacent cells also tend to be transcriptionally/epigenetically similar, suggesting that spatial proximity reflects feature similarity in the raw data.
#'   \item{\strong{Median Feature-Graph Similarity to Feature-Graph Neighbors (MFS-FGN):}} For each cell, this metric finds its `k` nearest neighbors based on *feature similarity* (from the `feature_graph`). It then calculates the median of the actual *feature similarity scores* (from the `feature_graph` itself) to these `k` feature-similar cells. This serves as a sanity check: a \strong{higher} median similarity indicates that the `feature_graph` is indeed connecting highly similar cells in feature space, validating the graph construction process itself.
#'   \item{\strong{Median Feature-Graph Distance to Spatial Neighbors (MFD-SN):}} For each cell, this metric finds its `k` nearest neighbors based on *spatial proximity*. It then calculates the median *feature-graph distance* (derived as `1 - similarity` from the `feature_graph`) between the query cell and these `k` spatially close neighbors. A \strong{lower} median graph distance (meaning higher graph similarity) indicates that spatially adjacent cells are also strongly connected in the feature-based graph, reinforcing that spatial proximity corresponds to feature-based graph connectivity.
#'   \item{\strong{Combined Coherence Score (CCS):}} This composite score combines the two primary distance-based metrics (MSD-FGN and MFD-SN) into a single value where a \strong{higher} score indicates better overall spatial-feature coherence. Each component metric is min-max normalized (0-1), then transformed so that higher values imply "better coherence" (e.g., `1 - normalized_distance`), and finally averaged.
#' }
#'
#' @param feature_graph A sparse matrix (cells x cells) representing feature-based
#'   cell-to-cell similarities (e.g., RNA graph or ATAC graph). Rownames/Colnames must be cell IDs.
#' @param feature_matrix_for_similarity A sparse matrix (features x cells) used for calculating
#'   cosine similarity between cells for the "spatial neighbors" metric. Rownames are features,
#'   colnames are cell IDs, and must match `feature_graph`.
#' @param spatial_coords_df A data.frame (cells x 2) of spatial x, y coordinates.
#'   Rownames must be cell IDs and match those in `feature_graph`.
#' @param k_neighbors Integer, the number of nearest neighbors to consider for coherence assessment.
#' @param modality_name Character string (e.g., "RNA", "ATAC") for labeling results and plots.
#' @return A list containing:
#'   \itemize{
#'     \item `coherence_df`: A data.frame with metrics for each cell.
#'     \item `plot_dist_spatial_for_graph_nn`: ggplot object for MSD-FGN density.
#'     \item `plot_sim_graph_for_spatial_nn`: ggplot object for MFS-SN density.
#'     \item `plot_sim_graph_for_graph_nn`: ggplot object for MFS-FGN density.
#'     \item `plot_dist_graph_for_spatial_nn`: ggplot object for MFD-SN density.
#'     \item `plot_spatial_coherence_metrics`: ggplot object with spatial subplots for all metrics.
#'   }
#' @export
assessSpatialGraphCoherenceOverall <- function(feature_graph, feature_matrix_for_similarity, spatial_coords_df, k_neighbors = 10, modality_name = "Modality") {

  # --- 1. Input Validation and Alignment ---
  if (!is(feature_graph, "Matrix")) { stop("`feature_graph` must be a sparse matrix (e.g., dgCMatrix).") }
  if (!is(feature_matrix_for_similarity, "Matrix")) { stop("`feature_matrix_for_similarity` must be a sparse matrix (e.g., dgCMatrix).") }
  if (!is.data.frame(spatial_coords_df) || ncol(spatial_coords_df) < 2) { stop("`spatial_coords_df` must be a data.frame with at least two columns (x, y).") }
  if (is.null(rownames(feature_graph)) || is.null(rownames(spatial_coords_df)) || is.null(colnames(feature_matrix_for_similarity))) {
    stop("All input matrices/data.frames must have cell IDs (rownames for graphs/spatial, colnames for feature matrix).")
  }
  
  graph_cell_ids <- rownames(feature_graph)
  spatial_cell_ids <- rownames(spatial_coords_df)
  feature_cell_ids <- colnames(feature_matrix_for_similarity)

  common_cells <- Reduce(intersect, list(graph_cell_ids, spatial_cell_ids, feature_cell_ids))
  
  if (length(common_cells) == 0) {
    stop("No common cell IDs found across `feature_graph`, `feature_matrix_for_similarity`, and `spatial_coords_df`. Check data integrity.")
  }
  if (length(common_cells) < nrow(feature_graph) || length(common_cells) < nrow(spatial_coords_df) || length(common_cells) < ncol(feature_matrix_for_similarity)) {
    message("Warning: Some cells are not common across all inputs. Subsetting to ", length(common_cells), " common cells.")
  }

  feature_graph <- feature_graph[common_cells, common_cells, drop = FALSE]
  spatial_coords_df <- spatial_coords_df[common_cells, , drop = FALSE]
  feature_matrix_for_similarity <- feature_matrix_for_similarity[, common_cells, drop = FALSE]
  
  num_cells <- nrow(feature_graph)
  cell_ids <- rownames(feature_graph) # Now aligned and consistent

  if (num_cells <= 1) {
    message("Too few cells (<= 1) to assess spatial-graph coherence for ", modality_name, ". Returning empty results.")
    return(list(
      coherence_df = data.frame(cell_id = character(0), modality = character(0),
                                median_spatial_dist_of_graph_neighbors = numeric(0),
                                median_graph_sim_of_spatial_neighbors = numeric(0),
                                median_graph_sim_of_graph_neighbors = numeric(0),
                                median_graph_dist_of_spatial_neighbors = numeric(0),
                                combined_coherence_score = numeric(0)), 
      plot_dist_spatial_for_graph_nn = ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No data") + theme_void(),
      plot_sim_graph_for_spatial_nn = ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No data") + theme_void(),
      plot_sim_graph_for_graph_nn = ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No data") + theme_void(),
      plot_dist_graph_for_spatial_nn = ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No data") + theme_void(),
      plot_spatial_coherence_metrics = ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No data") + theme_void()
    ))
  }

  if (k_neighbors >= num_cells) {
    warning("`k_neighbors` (", k_neighbors, ") is greater than or equal to the number of cells (", num_cells, "). Adjusting `k_neighbors` to num_cells - 1.")
    k_neighbors <- max(1, num_cells - 1)
  }
  if (k_neighbors == 0) {
      stop("`k_neighbors` must be at least 1 after adjustments for coherence assessment.")
  }

  message("Assessing overall spatial-graph coherence for ", modality_name, " with k = ", k_neighbors, "...")

  # Pre-calculate spatial matrix for RANN and distance calculations
  spatial_coords_mat <- as.matrix(spatial_coords_df[, c("x", "y")])

  # Pre-calculate L2 norms for `feature_matrix_for_similarity` columns to optimize cosine similarity
  feature_matrix_norms <- sqrt(Matrix::colSums(feature_matrix_for_similarity * feature_matrix_for_similarity))

  # Initialize vectors to store results (ensure they are named correctly)
  median_spatial_dist_of_graph_neighbors_vec <- rep(NA_real_, num_cells) # Use NA_real_ to ensure numeric type
  median_graph_sim_of_spatial_neighbors_vec <- rep(NA_real_, num_cells)
  median_graph_sim_of_graph_neighbors_vec <- rep(NA_real_, num_cells) 
  median_graph_dist_of_spatial_neighbors_vec <- rep(NA_real_, num_cells) 

  message("  Calculating median spatial distances and graph similarities for graph neighbors (vectorized)...")
  
  graph_summary_dt <- as.data.table(Matrix::summary(feature_graph))
  data.table::setnames(graph_summary_dt, old = c("i", "j"), new = c("query_cell_idx", "neighbor_cell_idx"))
  graph_summary_dt <- graph_summary_dt[query_cell_idx != neighbor_cell_idx]

  if (nrow(graph_summary_dt) == 0) {
      warning("No non-self-loop edges found in feature_graph. Metrics for graph neighbors will be NA.")
  } else {
      x1 <- spatial_coords_mat[graph_summary_dt$query_cell_idx, 1]
      y1 <- spatial_coords_mat[graph_summary_dt$query_cell_idx, 2]
      x2 <- spatial_coords_mat[graph_summary_dt$neighbor_cell_idx, 1]
      y2 <- spatial_coords_mat[graph_summary_dt$neighbor_cell_idx, 2]
      
      graph_summary_dt[, spatial_distance := sqrt((x1 - x2)^2 + (y1 - y2)^2)]
      
      graph_neighbors_ranked <- graph_summary_dt[, head(.SD[order(-x)], k_neighbors), by = query_cell_idx]
      
      median_spatial_results <- graph_neighbors_ranked[, .(median_dist = median(spatial_distance, na.rm=TRUE)), by = query_cell_idx]
      median_graph_sim_results_of_graph_nn <- graph_neighbors_ranked[, .(median_graph_sim = median(x, na.rm=TRUE)), by = query_cell_idx]
      
      # Map Metric 1 results back
      median_spatial_dist_of_graph_neighbors_vec[median_spatial_results$query_cell_idx] <- median_spatial_results$median_dist
      # Map Metric 3 results back
      median_graph_sim_of_graph_neighbors_vec[median_graph_sim_results_of_graph_nn$query_cell_idx] <- median_graph_sim_results_of_graph_nn$median_graph_sim
  }

  
  # Create cached igraph object for (optional) weighted shortest paths
  # Build igraph once; keep as weighted graph where weight = 1 / (similarity + eps)
  # This makes larger similarity correspond to smaller path cost.
  eps_for_weight <- 1e-8
  # Copy feature_graph (sparse) and compute weights vector for edges
  sg <- feature_graph
  # Avoid altering original feature_graph
  sg_nz <- Matrix::summary(sg)  # i, j, x
  if (nrow(sg_nz) == 0) {
    message("Warning: feature_graph has no edges; weighted shortest-paths will not be used.")
    igraph_graph_cached <- NULL
  } else {
    # edge weights as cost = 1 / (sim + eps) so stronger sim => lower cost
    edge_costs <- 1 / (sg_nz$x + eps_for_weight)
    # create igraph from edge list (undirected)
    igraph_graph_cached <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
      d = data.frame(from = sg_nz$i, to = sg_nz$j, weight = edge_costs),
      directed = FALSE,
      vertices = data.frame(name = seq_len(num_cells))
    )
    # Remove self loops if any
    igraph_graph_cached <- igraph::simplify(igraph_graph_cached, remove.multiple = TRUE, remove.loops = TRUE,
                                           edge.attr.comb = list(weight = "min"))
  }
  # Note: igraph_graph_cached vertex ids correspond to integer indices 1..num_cells
  
  # ---- Extra igraph QC statistics (run once after igraph_graph_cached is built) ----
  if (!is.null(igraph_graph_cached)) {
    # Basic graph sizes
    n_nodes_igraph <- igraph::vcount(igraph_graph_cached)
    n_edges_igraph <- igraph::ecount(igraph_graph_cached)
  
    # Sparsity (edge density)
    graph_density_val <- igraph::edge_density(igraph_graph_cached, loops = FALSE) # edges / possible edges
  
    # Degree statistics (use integer degree)
    degs <- igraph::degree(igraph_graph_cached, mode = "all")
    deg_summary <- quantile(degs, probs = c(0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95, 0.99, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_deg <- mean(degs, na.rm = TRUE)
    median_deg <- median(degs, na.rm = TRUE)
    max_deg <- max(degs, na.rm = TRUE)
  
    # Proportion of isolated nodes (degree == 0)
    prop_isolated <- sum(degs == 0, na.rm = TRUE) / length(degs)
  
    # Connected component summary (on undirected graph)
    comps <- igraph::components(igraph_graph_cached, mode = "weak")
    n_components <- comps$no
    comp_sizes <- sort(comps$csize, decreasing = TRUE)
    largest_comp_frac <- if (length(comp_sizes) > 0) comp_sizes[1] / n_nodes_igraph else NA_real_
  
    # Approximate average path length & diameter only on largest component (compute on subgraph)
    # For large graphs, computing diameter/avg path length on entire graph is expensive. Do it on largest component only, with a cap.
    avg_path_length_lg <- NA_real_
    diameter_lg <- NA_real_
    largest_comp_threshold <- 5000  # adjust if you can afford bigger
    if (!is.na(largest_comp_frac) && comp_sizes[1] <= largest_comp_threshold) {
      largest_vids <- which(comps$membership == which.max(comps$csize))
      subg <- igraph::induced_subgraph(igraph_graph_cached, vids = largest_vids)
      # average path length (use unweighted or weighted as desired); here use weighted if weights exist
      if (!is.null(igraph::E(subg)$weight)) {
        avg_path_length_lg <- suppressWarnings(igraph::average.path.length(subg, directed = FALSE, weights = igraph::E(subg)$weight))
        diameter_lg <- suppressWarnings(igraph::diameter(subg, directed = FALSE, weights = igraph::E(subg)$weight))
      } else {
        avg_path_length_lg <- suppressWarnings(igraph::average.path.length(subg, directed = FALSE))
        diameter_lg <- suppressWarnings(igraph::diameter(subg, directed = FALSE))
      }
    } else {
      message("Skipping avg path length / diameter on largest component: size = ", ifelse(length(comp_sizes)>0, comp_sizes[1], NA), " > threshold (", largest_comp_threshold, ").")
    }
  
    # Clustering coefficient (transitivity) global
    transitivity_global <- suppressWarnings(igraph::transitivity(igraph_graph_cached, type = "global"))
  
    # Assortativity by degree
    assort_deg <- tryCatch({
      igraph::assortativity_degree(igraph_graph_cached, directed = FALSE)
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  
    # Save a compact diagnostics list in the environment for later use (or attach to return)
    igraph_qc <- list(
      n_nodes = n_nodes_igraph,
      n_edges = n_edges_igraph,
      density = graph_density_val,
      mean_degree = mean_deg,
      median_degree = median_deg,
      max_degree = max_deg,
      degree_quantiles = deg_summary,
      prop_isolated = prop_isolated,
      n_components = n_components,
      largest_component_size = ifelse(length(comp_sizes)>0, comp_sizes[1], NA_integer_),
      largest_component_fraction = largest_comp_frac,
      avg_path_length_largest = avg_path_length_lg,
      diameter_largest = diameter_lg,
      transitivity = transitivity_global,
      assortativity_degree = assort_deg
    )
  
    # Print concise summary to console
    message("igraph QC: nodes=", igraph_qc$n_nodes,
            " edges=", igraph_qc$n_edges,
            " density=", signif(igraph_qc$density, 3),
            " mean_deg=", signif(igraph_qc$mean_degree, 3),
            " median_deg=", igraph_qc$median_degree,
            " prop_isolated=", signif(igraph_qc$prop_isolated, 3),
            " n_components=", igraph_qc$n_components,
            " largest_comp_frac=", signif(igraph_qc$largest_component_fraction, 3))
  } else {
    message("igraph_graph_cached is NULL; skipping igraph QC statistics.")
  }
  
  
  message("  Calculating median graph similarities and graph distances for spatial neighbors...")
  
  all_spatial_nn_results <- RANN::nn2(data = spatial_coords_mat, k = k_neighbors + 1)
  
  for (i in 1:num_cells) {
    current_cell_id <- cell_ids[i]
    
    spatial_nn_indices <- all_spatial_nn_results$nn.idx[i, ]
    spatial_nn_indices <- spatial_nn_indices[spatial_nn_indices != i & spatial_nn_indices > 0] 
    spatial_nn_indices <- head(spatial_nn_indices, k_neighbors)

    if (length(spatial_nn_indices) > 0) {
      # Metric 2: Cosine Similarity from full feature matrix
      vec1 <- feature_matrix_for_similarity[, current_cell_id, drop = FALSE] 
      mat2 <- feature_matrix_for_similarity[, cell_ids[spatial_nn_indices], drop = FALSE] 
      
      dot_products <- as.vector(crossprod(vec1, mat2)) 
      
      current_cell_norm <- feature_matrix_norms[current_cell_id]
      spatial_nn_norms <- feature_matrix_norms[cell_ids[spatial_nn_indices]]
      
      denominators <- current_cell_norm * spatial_nn_norms
      graph_sim_to_spatial_nn_cosine <- ifelse(denominators == 0, 0, dot_products / denominators)
      
      median_graph_sim_of_spatial_neighbors_vec[i] <- median(graph_sim_to_spatial_nn_cosine, na.rm=TRUE)

      # # Metric 4: SAFE graph similarity -> graph distance
      # # Try to extract the vector of similarities from the sparse matrix. Access by integer indices:
      # # This returns a sparse 1 x k sparse matrix; coerce to numeric vector
      # sim_vec <- tryCatch({
      #   as.numeric(feature_graph[i, spatial_nn_indices, drop = TRUE])
      # }, error = function(e) {
      #   # fallback: extract via summary + lookup (slower but robust)
      #   tmp <- Matrix::summary(feature_graph[i, , drop = TRUE])
      #   # tmp$j gives neighbor column indices, tmp$x gives values
      #   mapped <- rep(0, length(spatial_nn_indices))
      #   if (nrow(tmp) > 0) {
      #     idx_map <- setNames(tmp$x, tmp$j)
      #     present <- intersect(as.character(spatial_nn_indices), names(idx_map))
      #     if (length(present) > 0) {
      #       mapped[match(as.integer(present), spatial_nn_indices)] <- as.numeric(idx_map[present])
      #     }
      #   }
      #   mapped
      # })
      # 
      # # Interpret missing/zero similarities as "no direct connection".
      # # If you want direct similarity distance: dist = 1 - sim (clamped 0..1)
      # graph_dist_to_spatial_nn <- 1 - sim_vec
      # graph_dist_to_spatial_nn[is.na(graph_dist_to_spatial_nn)] <- 1      # missing => max distance
      # graph_dist_to_spatial_nn[graph_dist_to_spatial_nn < 0] <- 0
      # graph_dist_to_spatial_nn[graph_dist_to_spatial_nn > 1] <- 1
      #
      # median_graph_dist_of_spatial_neighbors_vec[i] <- median(graph_dist_to_spatial_nn, na.rm = TRUE)

      # New Metric 4: weighted shortest-path to spatial neighbors (fall back to direct 1 - sim)
      # Attempt weighted shortest-paths (Dijkstra) from node i to the small set of spatial_nn_indices.
      # This is efficient because we only request distances to k targets (k small).
      graph_dist_vals <- rep(NA_real_, length(spatial_nn_indices))

      # First, try to compute shortest paths using igraph (weighted)
      if (!is.null(igraph_graph_cached)) {
        # igraph uses vertex sequence as numeric or names; our vertices are 1..num_cells
        # Use igraph::distances with v = i and to = spatial_nn_indices, weights = E(igraph)$weight
        # wrap in tryCatch to handle potential memory/time issues
        sp_try <- tryCatch({
          # distances returns 1 x length(targets) numeric matrix
          spd <- igraph::distances(igraph_graph_cached, v = as.character(i), to = as.character(spatial_nn_indices), weights = igraph::E(igraph_graph_cached)$weight)
          as.numeric(spd)
        }, error = function(e) {
          # fallback signal
          NULL
        }, warning = function(w) {
          NULL
        })

        if (!is.null(sp_try)) {
          # sp_try contains numeric distances; Inf for unreachable
          # Map Inf -> NA for now
          sp_try[is.infinite(sp_try)] <- NA_real_
          # We normalized later; but to keep range comparable to direct (0..1), we convert weighted cost to a pseudo-distance in [0,1]
          # Compute per-cell normalization: find finite spd and scale by (max finite spd) if >0
          if (all(is.na(sp_try))) {
            # all unreachable via weighted paths; leave as NA and fallback below
            graph_dist_vals[] <- NA_real_
          } else {
            # normalize by max finite spd for this source; ensures 0..1
            finite_max <- max(sp_try, na.rm = TRUE)
            if (finite_max == 0) {
              graph_dist_vals <- rep(0, length(sp_try))
            } else {
              graph_dist_vals <- sp_try / finite_max
            }
          }
        }
      }

      # If igraph failed OR yielded only NA (unreachable), fallback to direct edge-based distance: 1 - similarity
      if (all(is.na(graph_dist_vals))) {
        # Fast direct extraction of similarities from sparse matrix (dgCMatrix supports integer indexing)
        sim_vec <- tryCatch({
          as.numeric(feature_graph[i, spatial_nn_indices, drop = TRUE])
        }, error = function(e) {
          # robust fallback via summary lookup for this row
          tmp <- Matrix::summary(feature_graph[i, , drop = TRUE])
          mapped <- rep(0, length(spatial_nn_indices))
          if (nrow(tmp) > 0) {
            idx_map <- setNames(tmp$x, tmp$j)
            present <- intersect(as.character(spatial_nn_indices), names(idx_map))
            if (length(present) > 0) {
              mapped[match(as.integer(present), spatial_nn_indices)] <- as.numeric(idx_map[present])
            }
          }
          mapped
        })

        # compute direct distance and clamp
        direct_dist <- 1 - sim_vec
        direct_dist[is.na(direct_dist)] <- 1   # treat missing/no-edge as max distance
        direct_dist[direct_dist < 0] <- 0
        direct_dist[direct_dist > 1] <- 1

        graph_dist_vals <- direct_dist
      }

      # Final assignment: median graph distance for this cell (use na.rm; if all NA then set NA)
      if (all(is.na(graph_dist_vals))) {
        median_graph_dist_of_spatial_neighbors_vec[i] <- NA_real_
      } else {
        median_graph_dist_of_spatial_neighbors_vec[i] <- median(graph_dist_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
      }
      
    } else {
      # These will remain NA_real_ as initialized
    }
  }

  # Assemble results into a data frame
  coherence_df <- data.frame(
    cell_id = cell_ids,
    modality = modality_name,
    median_spatial_dist_of_graph_neighbors = median_spatial_dist_of_graph_neighbors_vec,
    median_graph_sim_of_spatial_neighbors = median_graph_sim_of_spatial_neighbors_vec,
    median_graph_sim_of_graph_neighbors = median_graph_sim_of_graph_neighbors_vec,
    median_graph_dist_of_spatial_neighbors = median_graph_dist_of_spatial_neighbors_vec
  )
  
  data.table::setDT(coherence_df)
  
  message("  DEBUG: NA counts per metric before na.omit():")
  print(coherence_df[, lapply(.SD, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))])

  initial_nrow_coherence_df <- nrow(coherence_df)
  coherence_df <- na.omit(coherence_df) # Remove any rows with NA in any metric
  
  if (nrow(coherence_df) < initial_nrow_coherence_df) {
      message(paste0("Info: Removed ", initial_nrow_coherence_df - nrow(coherence_df), " cells with NA coherence metrics via na.omit()."))
  }
  
  if (nrow(coherence_df) == 0) {
      message("CRITICAL WARNING: coherence_df is empty after removing NAs. All plots will be empty.")
      # Return empty plot objects, avoiding further processing that requires data
      return(list(
        coherence_df = data.data.frame(cell_id = character(0), modality = character(0),
                                  median_spatial_dist_of_graph_neighbors = numeric(0),
                                  median_graph_sim_of_spatial_neighbors = numeric(0),
                                  median_graph_sim_of_graph_neighbors = numeric(0),
                                  median_graph_dist_of_spatial_neighbors = numeric(0),
                                  combined_coherence_score = numeric(0)), 
        plot_dist_spatial_for_graph_nn = ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No data") + theme_void(),
        plot_sim_graph_for_spatial_nn = ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No data") + theme_void(),
        plot_sim_graph_for_graph_nn = ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No data") + theme_void(),
        plot_dist_graph_for_spatial_nn = ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No data") + theme_void(),
        plot_spatial_coherence_metrics = ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No data") + theme_void()
      ))
  }


  # --- Calculate Combined Coherence Score (Metric 5) ---
  msd_fgn_vals <- coherence_df[["median_spatial_dist_of_graph_neighbors"]]
  min_msd_fgn <- min(msd_fgn_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_msd_fgn <- max(msd_fgn_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  norm_msd_fgn <- if (max_msd_fgn == min_msd_fgn) {
      rep(0.5, length(msd_fgn_vals))
  } else {
      1 - (msd_fgn_vals - min_msd_fgn) / (max_msd_fgn - min_msd_fgn)
  }

  mfd_sn_vals <- coherence_df[["median_graph_dist_of_spatial_neighbors"]]
  min_mfd_sn <- min(mfd_sn_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_mfd_sn <- max(mfd_sn_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  norm_mfd_sn <- if (max_mfd_sn == min_mfd_sn) {
      rep(0.5, length(mfd_sn_vals))
  } else {
      1 - (mfd_sn_vals - min_mfd_sn) / (max_mfd_sn - min_mfd_sn)
  }
  
  coherence_df$combined_coherence_score <- (norm_msd_fgn + norm_mfd_sn) / 2


  # --- Plotting Distributions (Density Plots) ---
  plot_dist_spatial_for_graph_nn <- ggplot(coherence_df, aes(x = median_spatial_dist_of_graph_neighbors)) +
    geom_density(fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = paste0(modality_name, ": Spatial Dist to Feature-Graph NN (k=", k_neighbors, ")"), # More descriptive
         x = "Median Spatial Distance", y = "Density") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  plot_sim_graph_for_spatial_nn <- ggplot(coherence_df, aes(x = median_graph_sim_of_spatial_neighbors)) +
    geom_density(fill = "lightcoral", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = paste0(modality_name, ": Feature Sim to Spatial NN (k=", k_neighbors, ")"), # More descriptive
         x = "Median Feature Similarity", y = "Density") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  plot_sim_graph_for_graph_nn <- ggplot(coherence_df, aes(x = median_graph_sim_of_graph_neighbors)) +
    geom_density(fill = "lightgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = paste0(modality_name, ": Feature Sim to Feature-Graph NN (k=", k_neighbors, ")"), # More descriptive
         x = "Median Feature Similarity", y = "Density") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  plot_dist_graph_for_spatial_nn <- ggplot(coherence_df, aes(x = median_graph_dist_of_spatial_neighbors)) +
    geom_density(fill = "lightgoldenrod", alpha = 0.7) + 
    labs(title = paste0(modality_name, ": Feature-Graph Dist to Spatial NN (k=", k_neighbors, ")"), # More descriptive
         x = "Median Feature-Graph Distance", y = "Density") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  # --- Spatial Plot with Color Gradients for all Metrics ---
  message("  Generating spatial plot with coherence metric gradients...")

  spatial_coords_df_for_merge <- as.data.frame(spatial_coords_df) 
  if (!"cell_id" %in% colnames(spatial_coords_df_for_merge)) {
    spatial_coords_df_for_merge$cell_id <- rownames(spatial_coords_df_for_merge)
  }
  
  # Default empty plot if no data is available
  p_spatial_metrics <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No data for spatial plot") + theme_void() 
  
  # Only attempt to create the spatial plot if coherence_df has data
  if (nrow(coherence_df) > 0) {
      plot_data_spatial <- merge(spatial_coords_df_for_merge, coherence_df, by = "cell_id", all.x = TRUE)
      
      # It's possible for some original cells not to have been included in coherence_df if they had NAs.
      # These will show as NA for metrics but should still be plotted as grey.
      
      plot_data_long <- plot_data_spatial %>%
        tidyr::pivot_longer(
          cols = c(median_spatial_dist_of_graph_neighbors, 
                   median_graph_sim_of_spatial_neighbors, 
                   median_graph_sim_of_graph_neighbors, 
                   median_graph_dist_of_spatial_neighbors,
                   combined_coherence_score),
          names_to = "metric_type",
          values_to = "metric_value"
        )

      metric_labels <- c(
        median_spatial_dist_of_graph_neighbors = "Spatial Dist. to Feature-Graph NN",
        median_graph_sim_of_spatial_neighbors = "Feature Sim. to Spatial NN",
        median_graph_sim_of_graph_neighbors = "Feature Sim. to Feature-Graph NN",
        median_graph_dist_of_spatial_neighbors = "Feature-Graph Dist. to Spatial NN",
        combined_coherence_score = "Combined Coherence Score"
      )
      
      plot_data_long$metric_type <- factor(plot_data_long$metric_type, levels = names(metric_labels), labels = metric_labels)

      plot_data_long_normalized <- plot_data_long %>%
        group_by(metric_type) %>%
        mutate(
          val_min = min(metric_value, na.rm = TRUE),
          val_max = max(metric_value, na.rm = TRUE),
          norm_val = case_when(
              val_max == val_min ~ rep(0.5, n()),
              TRUE ~ (metric_value - val_min) / (val_max - val_min)
          ),
          plot_color_value = case_when(
            grepl("Dist", metric_type) ~ 1 - norm_val, 
            TRUE ~ norm_val 
          )
        ) %>%
        ungroup()
      
      # Final check before plotting the spatial facets
      # If plot_data_long_normalized is empty or all plot_color_value are NA, it will remain the default empty plot
      if (nrow(plot_data_long_normalized) > 0 && !all(is.na(plot_data_long_normalized$plot_color_value))) {
          p_spatial_metrics <- ggplot(plot_data_long_normalized, aes(x = x, y = y, color = plot_color_value)) +
            geom_point(size = 0.1, alpha = 0.6) +
            facet_wrap(~metric_type, ncol = 3) +
            scale_color_viridis_c(
              option = "viridis",
              direction = 1, # High plot_color_value (good coherence) will be bright yellow/green
              na.value = "grey80", # Cells with NA metrics will be grey
              name = "Coherence (Normalized)" 
            ) +
            labs(title = paste0(modality_name, ": Spatial Coherence Metrics (k=", k_neighbors, ")"),
                 x = "Spatial X", y = "Spatial Y") +
            coord_fixed() +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "bottom")
      } else {
          message("Warning: Spatial plot data (after normalization/NA handling) is empty or all NA for coloring. Returning empty spatial plot for this modality.")
      }
  }

  message("Overall spatial-graph coherence assessment complete for ", modality_name, ".")

  out_list <- list(
    coherence_df = coherence_df,
    plot_dist_spatial_for_graph_nn = plot_dist_spatial_for_graph_nn,
    plot_sim_graph_for_spatial_nn = plot_sim_graph_for_spatial_nn,
    plot_sim_graph_for_graph_nn = plot_sim_graph_for_graph_nn,
    plot_dist_graph_for_spatial_nn = plot_dist_graph_for_spatial_nn,
    plot_spatial_coherence_metrics = p_spatial_metrics
  )

  if (exists("igraph_qc")) {
    out_list$igraph_qc <- igraph_qc
  } else {
    out_list$igraph_qc <- NULL
  }

  return(out_list)
}
```

```{r Execute Spatial Multi-Omics Preprocessing}
# Define filtering parameters (adjust as per your data's spatial extent)
my_filter_params <- list(
  x_min_rna = 4700, x_max_rna = 10100, 
  x_min_atac = -Inf, x_max_atac = Inf, # Keep ATAC x-range broad for imputation
  y_min_rna = -Inf, y_max_rna = Inf, 
  y_min_atac = 4000, y_max_atac = Inf,
  proximity_radius = 50, 
  min_neighbors_rna = 10, min_neighbors_atac = 5
)

# Run the full preprocessing pipeline
preprocessed_data <- preprocessSpatialMultiomics(
  rna_h5_path = XENIUM_H5_PATH,
  cells_csv_path = XENIUM_CELLS_CSV_PATH,
  atac_h5ad_path = ATAC_H5AD_PATH,
  atac_x_col = "xcor", 
  atac_y_col = "ycor", 
  genome = "hg38", 
  mirror_rna_y = TRUE, 
  filter_params = my_filter_params
)

# Extract results
seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed <- preprocessed_data$seurat_obj_rna
rna_spatial_coords_filtered <- preprocessed_data$rna_spatial_coords
atac_counts_matrix_filtered <- preprocessed_data$atac_counts_matrix
atac_peaks_gr_filtered <- preprocessed_data$atac_peaks_gr
atac_spatial_coords_filtered <- preprocessed_data$atac_spatial_coords

message("Summary of preprocessed data:")
message("  RNA Seurat object (cells x genes): ", paste(dim(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed), collapse = "x"))
message("  RNA spatial coordinates (cells x 2): ", paste(dim(rna_spatial_coords_filtered), collapse = "x"))
message("  ATAC counts matrix (cells x peaks): ", paste(dim(atac_counts_matrix_filtered), collapse = "x"))
message("  ATAC peaks GRanges: ", length(atac_peaks_gr_filtered), " regions")
message("  ATAC spatial coordinates (cells x 2): ", paste(dim(atac_spatial_coords_filtered), collapse = "x"))

# Plot the filtered spatial data
p_filtered_spatial <- plot_spatial_rna_atac(
  rna_spatial_coords_filtered, 
  atac_spatial_coords_filtered, 
  same_limits = TRUE,
  rna_title = "Filtered Spatial RNA-seq",
  atac_title = "Filtered Spatial ATAC-seq"
)
print(p_filtered_spatial)
```

```{r Running CellWalker2 with RNA Graph}
# Ensure RNA data is clustered for mock markers
message("Clustering RNA data to derive mock markers...")

if (is.null(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed@reductions$pca)) {
  stop("PCA has not been run on the Seurat object. Please ensure `RunPCA` was successful in `preprocessSpatialMultiomics`.")
}
if (ncol(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed@reductions$pca@cell.embeddings) < 2) {
  stop(paste0("PCA yielded insufficient principal components (", ncol(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed@reductions$pca@cell.embeddings), 
              ") for `FindNeighbors`. Consider adjusting `rna_nfeatures` or `dims` parameters if you have very few cells/features."))
}

# Always run FindNeighbors and FindClusters here, as clustering is required for mock markers.
seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed <- FindNeighbors(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed, dims = graph_params$rna_feature_dims)
seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed <- FindClusters(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed, resolution = 0.5)

# Verify that 'seurat_clusters' exists after FindClusters
if (!("seurat_clusters" %in% names(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed@meta.data))) {
  warning("`FindClusters` did not create the 'seurat_clusters' metadata column. This might indicate an issue with clustering (e.g., too few cells, no variable features). Generating dummy markers.")
  
  # Fallback: Assign a dummy cluster to all cells to allow Idents to be set
  dummy_cluster_name <- "dummy_cluster_0"
  seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed$seurat_clusters <- factor(rep(dummy_cluster_name, ncol(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed)))
  
  # Generate dummy markers from the first few genes if clustering failed
  dummy_genes <- rownames(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed)[1:min(10, nrow(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed))]
  mock_markers_rna_df <- data.frame(
    gene = dummy_genes,
    cluster = rep(dummy_cluster_name, length(dummy_genes)),
    avg_log2FC = runif(length(dummy_genes), 0.5, 1.5),
    row.names = dummy_genes # Add row names for consistency
  )
} else {
  # If seurat_clusters exists, proceed as normal
  Idents(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed) <- "seurat_clusters"
  mock_markers_rna <- FindAllMarkers(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

  # Original check for empty markers is still valuable
  if (nrow(mock_markers_rna) == 0) {
    warning("No markers found for RNA clusters after `FindAllMarkers`. Generating dummy markers for demonstration.")
    dummy_genes <- rownames(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed)[1:min(10, nrow(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed))]
    dummy_clusters <- unique(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed$seurat_clusters)[1] # Take first cluster found
    mock_markers_rna_df <- data.frame(
      gene = dummy_genes,
      cluster = rep(dummy_clusters, length(dummy_genes)),
      avg_log2FC = runif(length(dummy_genes), 0.5, 1.5),
      row.names = dummy_genes
    )
  } else {
    mock_markers_rna_df <- as.data.frame(mock_markers_rna)
    mock_markers_rna_df <- mock_markers_rna_df[, c("gene", "cluster", "avg_log2FC")]
  }
}

# Compute label edges from RNA data
rna_label_expr_norm <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj_rna_preprocessed, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")

# Filter `rna_label_expr_norm` to only include genes present in `mock_markers_rna_df`
genes_in_markers <- unique(mock_markers_rna_df$gene)
rna_label_expr_norm_filtered <- rna_label_expr_norm[intersect(genes_in_markers, rownames(rna_label_expr_norm)), , drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(rna_label_expr_norm_filtered) == 0) {
  stop("No common genes between RNA expression data and mock markers after filtering. Cannot compute label edges for CellWalker.")
}

rna_label_edges <- changedCellWalkercomputeTypeEdges(rna_label_expr_norm_filtered, mock_markers_rna_df)
message("Dimensions of RNA label edges: ", paste(dim(rna_label_edges), collapse = "x"))

label_edges_list_walk <- list(rna_label_edges)
label_edge_weights_walk <- c(1000) # This would typically be tuned

message("Running walkCells with the RNA graph and RNA-derived label edges...")
cell_walk_results_rna <- CellWalkR::walkCells( 
  cellEdges = rna_graph,
  labelEdgesList = label_edges_list_walk,
  labelEdgeWeights = label_edge_weights_walk,
  sampleDepth = min(2000, nrow(rna_graph)) 
)

message("CellWalker results obtained with RNA multi-omics:")
print(head(cell_walk_results_rna$cellLabels)) # Renamed result variable
```

```{r Spatial Validation of Separate Graphs}
ggsave("/projectnb/paxlab/phitro/CellWalkR2/R/figure/RNA_plot_sim_graph_for_graph_nn.png", plot = rna_coherence_results$plot_sim_graph_for_graph_nn)
ggsave("/projectnb/paxlab/phitro/CellWalkR2/R/figure/RNA_plot_dist_graph_for_spatial_nn.png", plot = rna_coherence_results$plot_dist_graph_for_spatial_nn)

head(rna_coherence_results$coherence_df)

# --- For ATAC ---
atac_coherence_results <- assessSpatialGraphCoherenceOverall(
  feature_graph = atac_graph,
  feature_matrix_for_similarity = atac_feature_matrix_for_sim, 
  spatial_coords_df = atac_spatial_coords_filtered,
  k_neighbors = k_coherence_neighbors,
  modality_name = "ATAC"
)
print(atac_coherence_results$plot_dist_spatial_for_graph_nn)
print(atac_coherence_results$plot_sim_graph_for_spatial_nn)
print(atac_coherence_results$plot_sim_graph_for_graph_nn)
print(atac_coherence_results$plot_dist_graph_for_spatial_nn)
print(atac_coherence_results$plot_spatial_coherence_metrics)
ggsave("/projectnb/paxlab/phitro/CellWalkR2/R/figure/ATAC_plot_dist_spatial_for_graph_nn.png", plot = atac_coherence_results$plot_dist_spatial_for_graph_nn)
ggsave("/projectnb/paxlab/phitro/CellWalkR2/R/figure/ATAC_plot_sim_graph_for_spatial_nn.png", plot = atac_coherence_results$plot_sim_graph_for_spatial_nn)
ggsave("/projectnb/paxlab/phitro/CellWalkR2/R/figure/ATAC_plot_sim_graph_for_graph_nn.png", plot = atac_coherence_results$plot_sim_graph_for_graph_nn)
ggsave("/projectnb/paxlab/phitro/CellWalkR2/R/figure/ATAC_plot_dist_graph_for_spatial_nn.png", plot = atac_coherence_results$plot_dist_graph_for_spatial_nn)
ggsave("/projectnb/paxlab/phitro/CellWalkR2/R/figure/ATAC_plot_spatial_coherence_metrics.png", plot = atac_coherence_results$plot_spatial_coherence_metrics)
head(atac_coherence_results$coherence_df)

# --- Combine results for joint plotting (recommended for comparison) ---
combined_coherence_df <- rbind(rna_coherence_results$coherence_df, atac_coherence_results$coherence_df)

# Joint Density Plot: Median Spatial Distance for Graph Neighbors (RNA vs ATAC)
p_joint_spatial_dist <- ggplot(combined_coherence_df, aes(x = median_spatial_dist_of_graph_neighbors, fill = modality)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6, adjust = 1.5) + # `adjust` parameter controls smoothness of density plot
  labs(title = paste0("Median Spatial Distance of Graph Neighbors (k=", k_coherence_neighbors, ")"),
       x = "Median Spatial Distance (Lower = Better Coherence)", y = "Density", fill = "Modality") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
print(p_joint_spatial_dist)
ggsave("/projectnb/paxlab/phitro/CellWalkR2/R/figure/p_joint_spatial_dist.png", plot = p_joint_spatial_dist)

# Joint Density Plot: Median Graph Similarity for Spatial Neighbors (RNA vs ATAC)
p_joint_graph_sim <- ggplot(combined_coherence_df, aes(x = median_graph_sim_of_spatial_neighbors, fill = modality)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6, adjust = 1.5) +
  labs(title = paste0("Median Graph Similarity of Spatial Neighbors (k=", k_coherence_neighbors, ")"),
       x = "Median Graph Similarity (Higher = Better Coherence)", y = "Density", fill = "Modality") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
print(p_joint_graph_sim)
ggsave("/projectnb/paxlab/phitro/CellWalkR2/R/figure/p_joint_graph_sim.png", plot = p_joint_graph_sim)

# Optional: Scatter plot comparing the two metrics per cell, colored by modality
p_scatter_metrics <- ggplot(combined_coherence_df, aes(x = median_spatial_dist_of_graph_neighbors, y = median_graph_sim_of_spatial_neighbors, color = modality)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") + # Add a linear regression line
  labs(title = paste0("Spatial-Graph Coherence per Cell (k=", k_coherence_neighbors, ")"),
       x = "Median Spatial Distance of Graph Neighbors (Lower = Better)",
       y = "Median Graph Similarity of Spatial Neighbors (Higher = Better)",
       color = "Modality") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
print(p_scatter_metrics)
ggsave("/projectnb/paxlab/phitro/CellWalkR2/R/figure/p_scatter_metrics.png", plot = p_scatter_metrics)
```
